name: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd.
business_summary: Household and personal-care company: household insecticides (Good Knight, HIT), soaps (Cinthol, No.1, Godrej), hair colour (Godrej Expert), air care and fabric care in India, plus Indonesia (Megasari, Stella), Africa and Latin America. TTM sales Rs 16,537 cr, EBITDA Rs 3,343 cr (20%), profit Rs 1,977 cr; Sep-26 quarter sales Rs 4,413 cr (+19% y/y), EBITDA 19%, PAT Rs 523 cr (+14%). Management guided high-teens Q2 revenue growth, but margin contraction on palm oil, crude derivatives and packaging inflation sent the stock down 7% to a four-year low on 2026-10-30. Promoters 53.05%; FIIs sold from 13.9% to 11.0% in two quarters, DIIs rose to 20.7%.

exposures.mechanism: Palm oil and derivatives (soap noodles, fatty acids) ~18% of costs = Rs 2,375 cr on TTM cost base Rs 13,194 cr; +10% -> Rs 237 cr = 7.1% of EBITDA (Rs 3,343 cr). Company is taking 'calibrated pricing actions' (NDTV Profit 2026-10-05), recovering ~40%, so 60% unrecovered x persistence 0.4 x EV/MCap 1.05 => -1.8. Series is soybean oil (ZS=F) so basis risk vs palm. Oct-2026 Q2 margin contraction was the stated reason for the 7% fall on 2026-10-30.

evidence.note: Q2/H1 FY27 financials per screener.in pack; cost shares are model estimates unless stated

exposures.mechanism: Crude derivatives (LAB, solvents, aerosol propellants, polymer packaging) ~17% of costs with ~0.5 elasticity to Brent => +10% Brent ~ +0.85% of costs = Rs 112 cr = 3.4% of EBITDA x 0.6 x 0.4 x 1.05 => -0.9. Agrees with empirical -0.68 (t=-1.4, not significant). Brent +15% in 3m and +50% in 12m (factor_state).
